children: INVO Fertility furnished investor presentation for H.C. Wainwright conference and has sold about $3.59 million of common stock under its Any Market Purchase Agreement.
Furnished investor presentation for use at H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference Sept 14–16, 2026.
Presentation posted to the Investors section of INVO Fertility’s website on Aug 28, 2026; slides attached as Exhibit 99.1.
Company entered an Any Market Purchase Agreement with Alumni Capital granting up to $15M commitment (expandable to $50M by agreement).
Since registration effectiveness, sold 2,094,395 shares to the investor for approximately $3,591,000 at an average price of ~$1.71/share.
Exhibit 99.1 contains forward-looking statements; materials furnished and not “filed” under Section 18 of the Exchange Act.
